title: Audit entries outlive their objects and aren't hard-deleted
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). Open the audit trail wherever the build surfaces it for the asset/customer and check entries against the action you just performed.
  2. A disposable test asset you can unenrol, a schedule you can archive, and a work order link an audited action references. Seed: perform audited actions on the asset/schedule first so entries exist.
custom_steps:
1. Unenrol an asset that carries audit entries and confirm the entries remain.
  2. Archive a schedule that carries audit entries and confirm the entries remain.
  3. Confirm a work order link referenced by the trail is never hard-deleted.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Audit entries outlive the objects they describe; nothing that carries one is hard-deleted.
  • A work order link referenced by the trail is never hard-deleted.
  • An unenrolled asset and an archived schedule keep their entries.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S21; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S21-R6: “Audit entries will outlive the objects they describe. Nothing that carries one is hard deleted”
  • S21-N1: “A work order link is never hard deleted, or the trail goes with it”
  • S21-N2: “An unenrolled asset and an archived schedule keep their entries”
